idleLines: The field lights look brighter tonight, don't they? That's what a neighbour does.
contacts.job: Drink stand by the field gate

mission.done: Ball back in play. Miki tells you which way the wind runs today.

introLines.text: Hello! I'm Miki. I live just up the street, by the field.
My little brother's ball rolled away during practice. It's somewhere on the field — could you find it for me?
Of course. I'll look on the field.

steps.hint: Balls keep landing in her bottle crate.
steps.label: Talk to Miki

steps.hint: Tap the ball in the grass.
steps.label: Find the lost ball

steps.hint: Walk back to the drink stand.
steps.label: Bring it back to Miki

mission.title: The Lost Ball

contacts.name: Miki

idleLines: The dust comes back. So do I. That is the whole job.

mission.done: The step is clean, for a beat. The district remembers a gone house, then lets go.

introLines.text: One step is always dusty. I sweep it every morning.
Sweep it with me, then stand back and look. You'll see.

steps.hint: Tap the dusty step — sweep it with him.
steps.label: Sweep the dusty step

steps.hint: It clears, then dusts over again.
steps.label: Stand back and look

mission.title: The Step That Is Always Dusty

contacts.name: Old Jiro

idleLines: The wind is right today. Another kite, another roof, sooner or later.

mission.done: The kite comes down. The view stays: field, fading houses, stadium, Japan beyond.

introLines.text: My kite is stuck on the stadium roof. The wind put it there.
Follow it — field to stadium — and bring it down.

steps.hint: Her kite is stuck on the stadium roof.
steps.label: Talk to Aya

steps.hint: Walk the chase: housing rows, then the stadium.
steps.label: Follow the kite — field to stadium

steps.hint: Tap the kite on the roof.
steps.label: Bring the kite down

mission.title: The Kite on the Roof

contacts.name: Aya

dayJobs: Wednesday — market on the station road
Friday — night game under the lights

finds.effect: The chalk line never quite fades. It redraws itself overnight.
finds.label: Chalk line

finds.effect: A house number, painted on a wall where the house is gone.
finds.label: House number

finds.effect: One seat in Ajinomoto Stadium has no number. Kept blank on purpose.
finds.label: Blank seat

future2029: 2029 — a question, in words only. The field is still here. The houses are fewer. What would you want this ground to still be, if the game moved away?
name: Chofu — The Tract

choices: Chase it down the station road.
side.intro: A pigeon takes the ball down the station road. Chase it — or don't. The pigeon always wins.
side.result: The pigeon wins. Everyone laughs. The ball comes back.
side.title: Pigeon Steals the Ball

subtitle: A district to walk: the field, housing rows fading house by house, Ajinomoto Stadium at the north end. Painted, present day.

npcs.name: Kenji
npcs.job: Opens the shutter of the shuttered shop
npcs.line: Shutter's stuck again. It opens when it wants to — like the rest of us.

npcs.name: Yuki
npcs.job: Chases a ball across the field
npcs.line: My ball went that way! No — that way! Chase it with me?

npcs.name: Mr. Hana
npcs.job: Sits on the bench by the field
npcs.line: This bench is the best seat in Chofu. The field does the talking.
